title: Lantern crossing
subtitle: One foggy night. Two endings. Your decisions are saved after every choice.

dock.title: The late lantern
dock.text:
The third flash from the lighthouse is seven minutes late. The bridge is rising, but your receipt says: Warehouse Seven, after the third light.

A figure disappears along the disused tracks.

choices.inspect: Inspect the writing on the receipt
choices.follow: Follow the figure along the tracks

ledger.title: The altered date
ledger.text:
Tide levels fill the back of the receipt. The last date has been scraped away and rewritten; the ink is still wet. It is signed by the missing lighthouse keeper.

A wrench taps against the railing below the tower.

choices.question: Ask the keeper at the tower

bridge.title: The bridge in the fog
bridge.text:
An empty cart stands at the center of the bridge, its wheels tied in place. Across the water, someone covers a lantern twice, then waits.

It could be a warning. It could be a call for help.

choices.cross: Pass the cart and keep walking

keeper.title: Seven minutes
keeper.text:
Shen spreads a maintenance plan on the steps.

“The old channel is not sealed. People are repairing it, and the port opened the sluice early tonight. Seven minutes is all I could buy them.”

She gives you the spare lantern. Her own has gone out.

choices.trust: Light the maintenance hatch for her

warehouse.title: Water behind the door
warehouse.text:
The paving outside is dry. Inside, seawater covers the floor. Three knocks come from below. A chain runs through a hatch and around the harbor bell.

Pulling it will open the hidden door. Ringing the bell will wake the whole port.

choices.chain: Pull the chain and enter alone
choices.bell: Ring the bell and call for help

rescue.title: After the tide
rescue.text:
Lanterns gather around the hatch. As the last worker reaches the steps, the third light finally flashes on time.

The missing keeper, wrapped in a blanket, hands you the other half of the receipt. The maintenance money paid for repairs nobody was allowed to record.

At dawn, you must decide who receives the evidence. Tonight, everyone came home.

smugglers.title: The second ledger
smugglers.text:
The hatch opens onto a dry service walkway. At its end: three workers, a tool chest and two contradictory ledgers. You lead the workers out, but cannot guard the chest.

By the time the lighthouse returns, port officials have taken the evidence.

You saved the workers. Convincing the harbor will take another night.
